evidence.description: Main UI decode function applies XOR 0x4949 to each 16-bit pixel in loop at 0x0026d11c-0x0026d128.
RGB565 color channel swap: extracts R/G/B from input, swaps red and blue positions using masks 0xf800/0x7e0/0x1f, returns (blue<<11)|(green<<5)|red.

Pre-rebranding UI blob (30-Sep-2022): 307,200 bytes = 2 frames × 320×240×2 bytes RGB565. Post-rebranding (5-Dec-2022): 460,800 bytes = 3 frames × 320×240×2 bytes. Additional frame shows Leon 雷奥 manufacturer logo (Sishui Qingshan Electronic Co., Ltd).
Display hardware: 2.8 inch TFT LCD, 18-pin FFC, SPI interface (SCL/SDA/SDO/CS + RS/A0 D/C pin), likely ILI9341 or ST7789V controller based on pinout and SPI protocol.

summary: The firmware decodes UI splash screen images stored as multi-frame 320x240 RGB565 blobs using a per-pixel XOR mask 0x4949 followed by red/blue channel swap. Pre-rebranding firmware (Sep 2022) stored 2 frames (boot + shutdown, 307 KB). Post-rebranding firmware (Dec 2022) stores 3 frames (Leon logo + boot + shutdown, 460 KB). Display is SPI-connected ILI9341/ST7789V controller.
title: UI Blob Decode Algorithm (XOR 0x4949 + BGR565 Color Swap)
